noctem.name: Noctem
noctem.effect: The Pokémon summons darkness and blots out the sky as it enters the battle.

intoxicate.name: Intoxicate
intoxicate.effect: Intoxicate causes all Normal-type moves used by the Pokémon to become Poison-type and receive a 30% power boost.

ice-cleats.name: Ice cleats
ice-cleats.effect: During hail the Speed stat of Pokémon with this Ability is doubled. A Pokémon with this Ability will take no damage from hail if it otherwise would.

spirit-call.name: Spirit call
spirit-call.effect: When a Pokémon with Spirit Call uses a Ghost-type move, the power will increase by 1.5× if the user has less than or equal to ⅓ of its maximum HP remaining.

shadow-call.name: Shadow call
shadow-call.effect: When a Pokémon with Shadow Call uses a Dark-type move, the power will increase by 1.5× if the user has less than or equal to ⅓ of its maximum HP remaining.

psycho-call.name: Psycho call
psycho-call.effect: When a Pokémon with Psycho Call uses a Psychic-type move, the power will increase by 1.5× if the user has less than or equal to ⅓ of its maximum HP remaining.

shadow-dance.name: Shadow dance
shadow-dance.effect: During intense darkness, the Speed stat of Pokémon with this Ability is doubled.

absolution.name: Absolution
absolution.effect: During intense darkness, Absolution increases the Pokémon's Special Attack by 50 percent, but the Pokémon loses 1/8 of its maximum HP at the end of each turn.

dark-rock.name: Dark rock
dark-rock.effect: Lengthens duration of New Moon and Noctem from 5 turns to 8 turns when used by the holder.

d-volcarona-armor.name: D volcarona armor
d-volcarona-armor.effect: Increases Delta Volcarona's base Defense stat from 65 to 85 and base Special Defense stat from 105 to 137 when held.

zekrom-armor.name: Zekrom armor
zekrom-armor.effect: Increases Zekrom's base Defense stat from 120 to 156 and base Special Defense stat from 100 to 130 when held.

tyranitar-armor.name: Tyranitar armor
tyranitar-armor.effect: Increases Tyranitar's base Defense stat from 110 to 143 and base Special Defense stat from 100 to 130 when held.

crystal-fragment.name: Crystal fragment
crystal-fragment.effect: Allows Delta Metagross (Ruin) to Crystallize into Crystal Delta Metagross (Ruin) when held during battle.

livewire.effect: Causes Pokemon that are switched in to be immediately Paralyzed.

dark-matter.effect: The unknown forces of the world are unleashed. The user must recharge next turn.

wildfire.effect: Burns the foe. If it is a Grass-type Pokemon, burns all Pokemon in their party weak to fire.

lunar-cannon.effect: A two-turn attack. The user gathers darkness, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

crystal-rush.effect: The user turns to solid crystal, hitting first.

new-moon.effect: The sky darkens to night, increasing the power of Dark- and Ghost-type moves.

draco-jet.effect: A draconic fury in which the user always attacks first.
